title: Chapter 46 The Breath Of Destiny
content:
Chapter 46 The Breath Of Destiny

When they saw Lu Xue, the Tiger clan members were puzzled.

"Huh? Human race? Haha, I'm just hungry."

The powerful tiger clan saw that it was a human race, and immediately looked disdainful. Then he stepped forward and wanted to catch Lu Xue.

Seeing this, the patriarch of the bear tribe became anxious.

That was summoned by him at a great price.

"stop!"

The patriarch of the bear clan immediately stood in front of Lu Xue.

"Get out of here!"

There was a bang.

The patriarch of the bear tribe was directly bombarded.

The gap in strength is very huge.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue's heart pounded. Are all living beings so terrifying in this world of spirits?

Standing there, Lu Xue had no intention of escaping.

And in their eyes, all this was already scared.

"Haha, it's really a waste."

However, the next moment, when the tiger clan's strong man was about to touch Lu Xue, a terrifying force suddenly surged out of Lu Xue's body.

boom!

Suddenly, the powerful tiger clan was wiped out and even the scum was left behind.

The terrifying force still did not stop, but went up the way, cutting through the sky, shattering the entire void with a huge roar.

Ga~

For a moment, both the tiger clan and the white bear clan were stunned.

That's a strong man in the third level of the Earth Realm, just disappearing like that? !

Moreover, is this power so terrifying that even the sky was broken.

Looking at the fragments of void falling from the sky, all the creatures present were shocked.

Lu Xue also breathed a sigh of relief when she was in place.

It's still my father's reliable.

"Hehe, Dad, I love you."

With his hands stretched out and feeling the power, Lu Xue raised her eyebrows slightly and then punched the tiger tribes.

These tigers actually dare to eat themselves, how could they let them go?

Boom!

A huge explosion sounded.

A huge cloud of mushrooms surged out of the area where the powerful tiger clans were, and the smoke of gunpowder dissipated.

There has been a ruin.

A few tiger hairs seemed to tell them that there were several powerful tiger tribes here.

When the remaining tiger tribe members saw this scene, they dared not stay there.

"Run, run!!"

In an instant, the strong men from the tiger clan died and fled.

Seeing this, Lu Xue did not continue to attack, but turned around with a proud face and looked at the cute white bear clan.

"Hehehehe."

Bears: shivering.

......

"Sir, are you still comfortable?"

The patriarch of the bear clan carefully pinched Lu Xue's shoulders and legs, and from time to time, there were delicious fruits handed to Lu Xue's mouth.

"Yeah~isn't bad."

Enjoying these services, Lu Xue showed a satisfied smile.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly said, "By the way, you don't have a name yet."

"Sir, my name,"

"You can call it broccoli in the future."

"ah?"

"What, you don't want to?"

"I will, sir, I will call it broccoli in the future."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded with satisfaction.

"It's about the same."

White Bear Clan Chief: Don’t bully the bear like this.

After enjoying for a while, Lu Xue stretched and then stood up.

Now that I am in another world, I should have to establish a foothold first, but her father is not here.

At the first moment, Lu Xue remembered Ao Qing.

Although Ao Qing is not by his side now, it should be fine to seek protection from the dragon clan.

At least I have such a good relationship with Ao Qing.

But where should I go to find the dragon clan?

This is not familiar with the place.

On the side, looking at Lu Xue's dazed and thoughtful look, the White Bear Clan Chief hesitated, "Sir, what are you thinking?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned and then said, "Do you know where the Dragon Clan is?"

When he heard the word "Dragon Clan", the White Bear Clan leader suddenly had white hair all over his body, obviously feeling quite exciting.

"Dragon Clan! Lord, what are you asking about the dragon Clan?"

The White Bear Clan leader said in a trembling voice.

Seeing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly. As for this reaction?

"Why are you so scared? You won't be bullied by the dragon, right?"

Upon hearing this, the White Bear Clan leader shook his head repeatedly.

"Sir, the Dragon Clan is one of the top clans in the entire world of all spirits. Any strong man in the Dragon Clan can destroy my White Bear Clan thousands of times."

"Besides, the dragon race is irritable and looks down on us as low-class races as the most."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's expression was slightly dark.

Although this guy's answer was not right, he also understood that it might be a bit difficult to seek protection from the dragon clan.

Didn't you even look down on me if you didn't see that the tiger clan looked down on me?

Then what should I do?

Just wait here until my dad comes to save me?

No, no.

Lu Xue shook her head decisively and gave up this idea.

This time I have to do something to prove myself.

It is also OK to prove yourself.

Otherwise, my dad dares to let himself come out next time?

Since that's the case, then go out and have a chance.

"I ask you, where is the place where my human race lives and how do you go?"

"ah?"

"What? I'll ask you where is the human race?"

Upon hearing this, the White Bear Clan Chief was confused.

No human race in the world of the world, the number of humans I have seen in my life is no more than one hand.

Then the White Bear Clan Chief hesitated and said, "Sir, there is no human race in the world of all spirits."

"What!"

Lu Xue was stunned.

There is no human race in the world of all spirits. Is it that all spirits of all spirits full of alien races?

At this time, the White Bear Clan Chief continued: "However, although there are no human race, there are still humans, but very few."

Hearing this, Lu Xue immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

Just someone is fine.

If she was really the only human in this world of spirits, she might have cried directly.

That was a lonely cry.

That's it.

"I'm leaving."

"Ah? Sir, where are you going?"

Lu Xue looked into the distant sky, learned from Lu Daosheng's appearance, and said slowly: "Go and see the beautiful mountains and rivers of this world, go to travel around the mountains, rivers, lakes and seas, and conquer,"

"What to conquer?"

The White Bear Clan Chief said in confusion.

However, he discovered that Lu Xue had already run away.

Because she has no words.

"Class leader, why did she run away? Who will protect us from now on?"

At this time, a white bear tribe member stepped forward and asked worriedly.

Suddenly, the wise expression of the White Bear Clan leader disappeared, and replaced by an extremely solemn expression.

Looking at Lu Xue's departure, he said in a deep voice: "This person has a despicable cause and effect on his body, which is not something that our clan can do. She solved the tiger clan, which is also a good thing for us, so let her Leave."

Of course, he couldn't stop him.

And far away.

Lu Xue suddenly stopped.

This world of all spirits is full of dangers, so it is better to be more stable.

Then Lu Xue turned it inward from her storage ring.

The dazzling treasures inside were almost blinding her Kazilan's big eyes.

These were all given to her by Lu Daosheng a long time ago.

Full of fatherly love.

"Hey, this is pretty good."

A small clock suddenly appeared in Lu Xue's hand.

The next moment, the little clock flew straight into her sea of consciousness. At the same time, an indescribable force enveloped her limbs and bones, not being attacked by external forces.

Defensive treasure.

The name of this treasure also appeared in Lu Xue's mind.

Chaos Bell.

.........

And somewhere in the world of all spirits.

A blue hall full of ancient aura suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, a dull sound slowly rang.

"The breath of destiny."

Suddenly, an aggressive gaze passed through the endless void and looked directly at a place in the All Spirit Realm.

However, there was nothing but a group of weak and boundless white bears.

"Did I feel wrong?"

"Or, he is deliberately hiding from me."
